final: WITH c AS (SELECT r.circuitId, ci.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, ci.country), b AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(avg_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS baseline FROM c) SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, avg_round - baseline AS diff FROM b ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
